Name: Lunar New Year Foods
Author: violetlizabet
Description:
In honor of Lunar New Year 2022, here's a small recipes pack containing eight traditional New Year's foods. 

[size=5]How to Use This Mod[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have SMAPI installed
[*]Install Json Assets and Mail Framework Mod
[*]Download this mod
[*]Unzip
[*]Place into mods folder
[*]Enjoy!
[/list]
[size=5]What Recipes Are Included[/size]
The recipes this mod installs are:
[list]
[*]﻿﻿Nian Gao
[*]Fa Gao
[*]Steamed Fish
[*]Dumplings
[*]Longevity Noodles
[*]Turnip Cake
[*]Buddha’s Delight
[*]Candy Box
[/list]Every villager loves at least one of the foods added by this mod. Generally, the recipes in this mod are somewhat profitable, but it should be fairly balanced with the base game recipes. Some of the foods add buffs, but again nothing out of the normal for the base game recipes. 

[size=5]How to Obtain Recipes[/size]
Around the first New Year's (end of winter year 1/early spring year 2), various villagers will send you letters with recipes attached or announcements of new recipes for sale in their shops. 

[size=5]Translations[/size]
Currently, this mod has English and Chinese (traditional and simplified) translations. If you have corrections, please let me know! If you'd like to contribute translations in other languages, also please let me know!
[size=5]
Exact Details on Recipes[/size]
For more information, see [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/10mIgAAvZPHzlMfi2CbuEQFJ4hesdbBGQ3vZ7wBHBSZ0/edit#gid=2092398395]this Google sheet[/url]﻿ with detailed information on all aspects of the recipes.
